title: Lost Puppy (F4F) (NO BINAURALS)
description:
I found you alone, shivering in the rain. Just like a lost little puppy. You mindlessly follow me as my footsteps guide you home.
I comfort you by my warm fire, and hold you in my arms…
Before you know it, my collar is locked around your neck.
Your mind is gone. Your thoughts replaced with “woof” and “ruff” as I have you sniffing my panties on the floor…while my feet press into your face.
Your special “chew toy” is strapped to your face…because puppies don’t get to speak until Master says so. They just pant, whimper, and obey.
I’ll have you humping my foot, drooling, and growling, like the dumb doggy that you are
That you love to be… all for me.
Nothing is better than being mine.
Nothing is better than being my puppy…
Even when I am a little evil. xx
Even if you think you “aren’t into feet”…
You’re into this.
I have a way of making you want things you never thought you would.
Now follow me home, puppy. Where you belong.
*This version is female gendered and suitable for trans femme listeners. Uses “good girl” and gender-neutral terms for anatomy.
author: Goddess Nichole
